prompt: VIX just spiked to 25. Should I roll my puts early, or wait? My positions are 12 DTE.

assertions.text: Analysis discusses IV impact on NEW put premiums (elevated cost) AND potential gain on OLD puts (IV lift)
Analysis presents a clear recommendation (roll now vs wait) with explicit reasoning
Framework citation present (hedging-strategies.md line 128 or similar)
Analysis does NOT generate a full roll ticket prematurely — offers to draft it if user confirms
Cost-to-roll math shown or described (new_premium − old_residual)
